paper_history.name: Bounded klt complements for Fano contractions
Uniform Cartier sections for Fano type contractions

credit.name: Will Cook, OpenAI Math Atlas; source manuscripts and Lean quotations credited to OpenAI.

value.scope:
The paper develops uniform Cartier sections for Fano-type contractions as a step toward bounded klt complements. The linked formalization proves a local compactness result: for positive numbers $a_i$, the chart-field retractions indexed by nonnegative weights satisfying $\sum_i a_iw_i=1$ form a compact set in the pointwise topology on the fraction field.

The chart is built over an algebraically closed field from the localization of a polynomial ring at its origin. Its local domain is Noetherian, essentially of finite type and formally unramified over that localization, and formally étale over the polynomial ring. Uniform Cartier sections, bounded klt complements, and the paper's real-boundary and companion conclusions are outside this supporting statement.
value.title: Bounded klt complements for Fano contractions

points.gap: The whole headline. The challenge proves only that, on a closed étale chart (local Noetherian domain A, essentially of finite type and formally unramified over the localization R of k[σ] at the origin, formally étale over k[σ], k algebraically closed), the family of chart-field retraction valuations K → WithTop ℝ indexed by weights w ≥ 0 with Σ aᵢwᵢ = 1 (all aᵢ > 0) is compact in the pointwise topology.

points.note: The Lean states only a topological compactness lemma: for k algebraically closed, a closed etale chart A with fraction field K (hypotheses in the variable block) and positive reals a_i, the monomial valuations K -> WithTop ℝ of weights w >= 0 with sum a_i w_i = 1 form a compact subset of K -> WithTop ℝ in the pointwise topology.
